heroSummary: Mesa Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Thursday, August 6, 2026. Fall Break runs October 5–9, Winter Break runs December 18 through January 1, Spring Break runs March 8–12, and the last day of school is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

sourceReviewDetails: We verified the first day, last day, breaks, federal holidays, professional learning days, early-release Wednesdays, elementary conference early releases, high school semester exam early releases, and grading-period end dates against the official MPS 2026–27 calendar.
MPS schedules a two-hour early release on most Wednesdays. Families should confirm exact bell times with their school.

calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official 2026–27 calendar lists a two-hour early release on most Wednesdays. Check your school’s bell schedule for the exact dismissal time.

calendarFaqs.q: Do professional learning days count as student attendance days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Professional learning days on this calendar are no-school days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Do conference and exam early-release dates apply to every student?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Parent-teacher conference early releases apply to elementary students, while semester exam early releases apply to high school students. Families should confirm bell times and campus-specific details with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later MPS revisions.
